research.question: Can independent bridge logos corroborate identity?
research.evidence: Official roles group Opta-derived providers together and classify StatsBomb/API-Football as bridge-only. This corroborates the pinned row buckets without upgrading the release.
research.selected_approach: Reject; preserve per-row pinned buckets and count upstream groups once
research.uncertainty_remaining: Public policy is not the private per-case source packet
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

research.question: Does public Reep engine code prove v1 matching rules?
research.evidence: README states the v1 engine is not public and v0 output is frozen; v0 IDs cannot be used as v1 proof.
alternatives_considered: Inspect frozen v0 code or aliases as v1 adjudication evidence
research.selected_approach: Reject; exact pinned bridge/rule identifiers retained as candidates only
research.uncertainty_remaining: Per-case v1 rule rationale and source packets unavailable
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

research.question: How should cross-provider namespaces be joined?
research.evidence: Provider namespaces distinguish StatsBomb offline_team from API-Football team. Stable release and redirect chain remain required.
alternatives_considered: Join bare numbers or latest hosted API
research.selected_approach: Use pinned release and exact scoped keys
research.uncertainty_remaining: No independent relationship follows merely from the join
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

research.question: Can a matching framework replace existing approval?
research.evidence: Indexing, comparison and classification are distinct steps. Existing MatchForge candidate/review code already covers this need.
research.selected_approach: Do not add dependency or scoring-based admission
research.uncertainty_remaining: No new historical proof supplied by a toolkit
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

research.question: Should reconciliation auto-approve similar names?
research.evidence: Reconciliation suggestions require reviewed judgment; existing Resolution Center already owns this workflow.
alternatives_considered: Build a parallel reviewer or bulk-admit names
research.selected_approach: Reuse existing review and require recognized evidence
research.uncertainty_remaining: Multi-field reviewed policy would require explicit approval before use
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

research.question: Is another documented ID mapping endpoint a StatsBomb bridge?
research.evidence: Published input providers include API-Football, Sportradar, Enetpulse, Sportal365 and Statscore; the reference does not document a StatsBomb offline namespace. A client/key is required.
research.selected_approach: No calls or spend; does not answer the specific missing StatsBomb relationship proof
research.uncertainty_remaining: No claim that no external proof exists globally
research.verification: Pinned artifact checksum/namespace/row checks and live read-only 21-mapping/19-anchor audit

conclusion: Bounded independent research found no retained independently verifiable StatsBomb-to-accepted-target relationship recognized by the current review contract. This is not proof that no such evidence exists elsewhere. Preserve all candidates; do not ask the owner to approve invalid proposals.
next_action: Obtain a retained exact source-to-target crosswalk with independently verifiable provenance for one team first, or an explicitly approved reviewed multi-field evidence policy. Then design only the missing prospective correction compatibility.
